registers.name: I2C_SCL_LOW_PERIOD_REG
registers.description: Configures the low level width of the SCL clock.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_LOW_PERIOD
fields.description: Configures for how long SCL remains low in master mode, in APB clock cycles.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_FORCE_OUT
fields.description: 0: direct output; 1: open drain output.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_FORCE_OUT
fields.description: 0: direct output; 1: open drain output.

fields.name: I2C_SAMPLE_SCL_LEVEL
fields.description: 1: sample SDA on SCL low level; 0: sample SDA on SCL high level.

fields.name: I2C_MS_MODE
fields.description: Set to configure as I2C Master. Clear to configure as I2C Slave.

fields.name: I2C_TRANS_START
fields.description: Set this bit to start sending the data in txfifo.

fields.name: I2C_TX_LSB_FIRST
fields.description: 1: send data from LSB; 0: send data from MSB.

fields.name: I2C_RX_LSB_FIRST
fields.description: 1: receive data from LSB; 0: receive data from MSB.

fields.name: I2C_ACK_REC
fields.description: Stores the value of the received ACK bit.

fields.name: I2C_SLAVE_RW
fields.description: In slave mode, 1: master reads from slave; 0: master writes to slave.

fields.name: I2C_TIME_OUT
fields.description: When the I2C controller takes more than I2C_TIME_OUT clocks to receive a data bit, changes to 1.

fields.name: I2C_ARB_LOST
fields.description: When the I2C controller loses control of SCL line, changes to 1.

fields.name: I2C_BUS_BUSY
fields.description: 1: I2C bus is busy transferring data; 0: I2C bus is idle.

fields.name: I2C_SLAVE_ADDRESSED
fields.description: High when configured as slave and address sent by master matches slave address.

fields.name: I2C_BYTE_TRANS
fields.description: Changes to 1 when one byte is transferred.

fields.name: I2C_RXFIFO_CNT
fields.description: Amount of data needed to be sent.

fields.name: I2C_TXFIFO_CNT
fields.description: Amount of received data in RAM.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_MAIN_STATE_LAST
fields.description: States of I2C module state machine.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_STATE_LAST
fields.description: States of the state machine used to produce SCL.

fields.name: I2C_TIME_OUT_REG
fields.description: Timeout for receiving a data bit in APB clock cycles.

fields.name: I2C_SLAVE_ADDR
fields.description: When configured as I2C Slave, this field configures the slave address.

fields.name: I2C_SLAVE_ADDR_10BIT_EN
fields.description: Enables slave 10-bit addressing mode in master mode.

fields.name: I2C_RXFIFO_START_ADDR
fields.description: Offset address of the last received data, as described in nonfifo_rx_thres register.

fields.name: I2C_RXFIFO_END_ADDR
fields.description: Offset address of the last received data. Refreshes when RX_REC_FULL_INT or TRANS_COMPLETE_INT is generated.

fields.name: I2C_TXFIFO_START_ADDR
fields.description: Offset address of the first sent data, as described in nonfifo_tx_thres register.

fields.name: I2C_TXFIFO_END_ADDR
fields.description: Offset address of the last sent data. Refreshes when TX_SEND_EMPTY_INT or TRANS_COMPLETE_INT is generated.

fields.name: I2C_RXFIFO_FULL_THRHD
fields.description: RX FIFO threshold in non-FIFO mode. When RX FIFO count > this value, RXFIFO_FULL_INT_RAW is valid.

fields.name: I2C_TXFIFO_EMPTY_THRHD
fields.description: TX FIFO threshold in non-FIFO mode. When TX FIFO count > this value, TXFIFO_EMPTY_INT_RAW is valid.

fields.name: I2C_NONFIFO_EN
fields.description: Set to enable APB nonfifo access.

fields.name: I2C_FIFO_ADDR_CFG_EN
fields.description: When set, byte received after I2C address byte represents offset address in I2C Slave RAM.

fields.name: I2C_NONFIFO_RX_THRES
fields.description: When I2C receives more than this many bytes, rx_send_full_int_raw interrupt is generated.

fields.name: I2C_NONFIFO_TX_THRES
fields.description: When I2C sends more than this many bytes, tx_send_empty_int_raw interrupt is generated.

fields.name: I2C_RXFIFO_FULL_INT_RAW
fields.description: Raw interrupt status bit for RX FIFO full threshold interrupt.

fields.name: I2C_TXFIFO_EMPTY_INT_RAW
fields.description: Raw interrupt status bit for TX FIFO empty threshold interrupt.

fields.name: I2C_RXFIFO_OVF_INT_RAW
fields.description: Raw interrupt status bit for RX FIFO overflow interrupt.

fields.description: Raw interrupt status bit for END command detected interrupt.

fields.name: I2C_SLAVE_TRAN_COMP_INT_RAW

fields.name: I2C_ARBITRATION_LOST_INT_RAW
fields.description: Raw interrupt status bit for Arbitration lost interrupt.

registers.name: I2C_SDA_HOLD_REG
registers.description: Configures the hold time after a negative SCL edge.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_HOLD_TIME
fields.description: Time to hold data after the negative edge of SCL, in APB clock cycles.

registers.name: I2C_SDA_SAMPLE_REG
registers.description: Configures the sample time after a positive SCL edge.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_SAMPLE_TIME
fields.description: Time to sample SDA after the positive edge of SCL, in APB clock cycles.

registers.name: I2C_SCL_HIGH_PERIOD_REG
registers.description: Configures the high level width of the SCL clock.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_HIGH_PERIOD
fields.description: Configures for how long SCL remains high in master mode, in APB clock cycles.

registers.name: I2C_SCL_START_HOLD_REG
registers.description: Configures the delay between the SDA and SCL negative edge for a start condition.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_START_HOLD_TIME
fields.description: Time between negative edge of SDA and negative edge of SCL for START condition, in APB clock cycles.

registers.name: I2C_SCL_RSTART_SETUP_REG
registers.description: Configures the delay between the positive edge of SCL and the negative edge of SDA for a RESTART condition.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_RSTART_SETUP_TIME
fields.description: Time between positive edge of SCL and negative edge of SDA for RESTART condition, in APB clock cycles.

registers.name: I2C_SCL_STOP_HOLD_REG
registers.description: Configures the delay after the SCL clock edge for a stop condition.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_STOP_HOLD_TIME
fields.description: Delay after the STOP condition, in APB clock cycles.

registers.name: I2C_SCL_STOP_SETUP_REG
registers.description: Configures the delay between the SDA and SCL positive edge for a stop condition.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_STOP_SETUP_TIME
fields.description: Time between positive edge of SCL and positive edge of SDA, in APB clock cycles.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_FILTER_THRES
fields.description: Pulses on SCL shorter than this value in APB clock cycles are ignored.

fields.name: I2C_SCL_FILTER_EN
fields.description: Filter enable bit for SCL.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_FILTER_THRES
fields.description: Pulses on SDA shorter than this value in APB clock cycles are ignored.

fields.name: I2C_SDA_FILTER_EN
fields.description: Filter enable bit for SDA.
